Section	Metric	Formula_or_Value	Units	Description
inputs	selected_mu	0.08	decimal	Set this manually to one of mu_expensive, mu_neutral, mu_cheap
inputs	selected_policy_cap	1.10	x	Set this manually to one of policy_cap_expensive, policy_cap_neutral, policy_cap_cheap
human_capital	pv_income	=(582000/(0.04-0.01))*(1-((1+0.01)/(1+0.04))^30)	SEK	Present value of net labor income growing annuity
human_capital	risk_adjusted_human_capital_H	=pv_income*0.60	SEK	Risk-adjusted human capital
kelly	target_risky_share_w_t	=0.50*((selected_mu-0.03)/(0.17^2))	x	Target risky share of total economic wealth
portfolio	raw_target_exposure_x_raw	=((target_risky_share_w_t*(250000+risk_adjusted_human_capital_H))-(0.40*risk_adjusted_human_capital_H))/250000)	x	Required risky exposure in financial portfolio before cap
portfolio	financing_gate	=IF(selected_mu<=0.05,1.00,selected_policy_cap)	x	No leverage if expected return is not above borrow rate
portfolio	final_target_exposure_x_target	=MIN(financing_gate,MAX(0,raw_target_exposure_x_raw))	x	Final portfolio equity exposure after cap and floor
regional	us_bucket_multiplier	1.00	x	Set manually depending on valuation bucket for US
regional	europe_bucket_multiplier	1.15	x	Set manually depending on valuation bucket for Europe
regional	japan_bucket_multiplier	1.15	x	Set manually depending on valuation bucket for Japan
regional	em_bucket_multiplier	1.00	x	Set manually depending on valuation bucket for EM
regional	us_adjusted	=0.65*us_bucket_multiplier	x	Adjusted US weight before renormalization
regional	europe_adjusted	=0.20*europe_bucket_multiplier	x	Adjusted Europe weight before renormalization
regional	japan_adjusted	=0.10*japan_bucket_multiplier	x	Adjusted Japan weight before renormalization
regional	em_adjusted	=0.05*em_bucket_multiplier	x	Adjusted EM weight before renormalization
regional	sum_adjusted	=us_adjusted+europe_adjusted+japan_adjusted+em_adjusted	x	Sum of adjusted regional weights
regional	us_final_weight	=us_adjusted/sum_adjusted	decimal	Final US share of equity allocation
regional	europe_final_weight	=europe_adjusted/sum_adjusted	decimal	Final Europe share of equity allocation
regional	japan_final_weight	=japan_adjusted/sum_adjusted	decimal	Final Japan share of equity allocation
regional	em_final_weight	=em_adjusted/sum_adjusted	decimal	Final EM share of equity allocation
regional	us_portfolio_weight	=final_target_exposure_x_target*us_final_weight	decimal	US weight in total portfolio
regional	europe_portfolio_weight	=final_target_exposure_x_target*europe_final_weight	decimal	Europe weight in total portfolio
regional	japan_portfolio_weight	=final_target_exposure_x_target*japan_final_weight	decimal	Japan weight in total portfolio
regional	em_portfolio_weight	=final_target_exposure_x_target*em_final_weight	decimal	EM weight in total portfolio
sanity	portfolio_volatility	=final_target_exposure_x_target*0.17	decimal	Approximate portfolio volatility under simple leverage scaling
sanity	expected_portfolio_return	=final_target_exposure_x_target*selected_mu-MAX(final_target_exposure_x_target-1,0)*0.05	decimal	Expected return net of borrowing cost on leveraged slice
sanity	expected_excess_over_cash	=final_target_exposure_x_target*(selected_mu-0.03)-MAX(final_target_exposure_x_target-1,0)*(0.05-0.03)	decimal	Expected excess return over cash
